ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major cryptocurrencies posted modest gains on the Delta India exchange, with Bitcoin up 0.48% to $81,471 and Ethereum climbing 1.68% to $2,664. Positive regulatory cues—such as the SEC’s tokenized‑stock push and Visa’s crackdown on meme‑coin credit‑card rewards—offset security concerns highlighted by a North Korean hack. The market remains broadly bullish heading into the day.
